nodes.text: One more keeping, if your boots will take it. My sister holds the *Last Lamp*, the worst mile of the High Road, below the pass. The flame can't travel, and Edda won't. So the word goes on foot.

choices.text: My boots are done for now.

nodes.text: That the flame is tended. And that I still set a bowl for her at midwinter. She won't say much back. That's how you'll know it landed.

choices.text: My boots are done for now.

nodes.text: Down the High Road, past the fork, up where the weather starts arguing. Her lamp is the one that doesn't go out.
Then warm them here a while. The word has kept for years; it keeps a little more.
